o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish كشی (kişi), ultimately from Proto-Common Turkic *kiši (“person”). Cognate with Turkish kişi (“person”).
From Proto-Turkic *baya. Cognate with dialectal Turkish bayak, Chuvash паҫӑр (paś̬ăr), etc.
From Russian пиджа́к (pidžák), from English pea jacket.

Borrowed from Arabic خَرْدَل (ḵardal).
Cognates
* Turkish hardal,
* Uzbek xantal,
* Uyghur خەنتەل (xentel),
* Tatar хәрдәл (xärdäl),
* Gagauz hardal,
* Crimean Tatar hardal,
* Kumyk хардал (xardal)
